title: chore(pm): delete the one-time stale-`finding` sweep tool; H63 keeps reporting
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xCjGpvHD4tRyZ72DtPifmqL)_

Part of #29471

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:整删一次性工具 `scripts/pm/sweep-stale-finding.mjs`,以及它的 package.json 别名、lint.yml 自测步骤与注释、write-pace 名册条目、dispatch-gates 的人口注释,和 H63 读取该工具源码的那组断言。H63 行与 `staleFindingScreen` 保留,继续报告。
- 为什么改:#29471 普查 T2;席位裁决 6593074237 收窄为「只删工具」。积压已清,工具不再有计划中的运行。
- 遗留:线上仍有 2 张定级后仍挂 `finding` 的卡(#28107、#28722),留给分诊轮次手工处理;H63 会一直报告它们直到处理完。
- H63 的提示语改为「已处于此状态的卡由分诊轮次手工去标」,不再指向被删的工具;判定逻辑不变(4096 种标签组合逐一比对,结果相同)。
- 风险与回滚:无行为删除,巡检行一条不少;可整 PR revert。动到 `.github/workflows/**`,属 Tier H,需维护者落地。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`,预期 5161 条全过(主干 5166)。
- 需要你做的:审阅并落地(Tier H)。

## What changes

- **Deleted**: `scripts/pm/sweep-stale-finding.mjs` (1,240 lines), the one-time `--write` sweep that stripped `finding` from graded cards under #16904's D1.
- **Its wiring, removed with it**:
  - `package.json`: the `check:pm-stale-finding` alias.
  - `.github/workflows/lint.yml`: the `Stale-\`finding\` sweep self-test` step and its rationale comment, and the tool's name in the write-pace step's comment and in the issue-transfer step's comment.
  - `scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs`: the tool's `WIRED_WRITE_TOOLS` entry, and the roster docblock's count (ten → nine, five board tools → four). The self-test's own summary already said "nine write transports".
  - `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`: the population note that named the tool as a sibling source the patrol's self-test reads. It now names only `check-prior-rulings.mjs`, which is still read.
- **`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`**, touched only where the seat ruled (6593074237, widened by the seat after the draft opened):
  - H63's source-text pin is deleted: the 5 `H63 ↔ sweep` cases that read the tool's file to check it still aliased `staleFindingScreen`, plus the clause in the H63 test preamble that described them.
  - The note "Why the rule LIVES HERE and the sweep imports it" is deleted. It explained the import direction between this file and the tool.
  - **H63's printed remedy is reworded.** It said "the standing backlog is the one-time sweep's, run once per board by the seat that owns it". It now says "a carrier already in this shape is the triage round's to fix by hand, removing the marker when it grades the card", which is what 「定级即离标」 asks for. The rest of the sentence, including "⛔ never a loop from here", is unchanged.
  - Comments and test names that described the tool as a second reader of the screen are reworded: the section title, H63's docblock and its "Why it fires on the screen's set" note, the sweep-loop comment, and four H63 test names or comments (one of them the case that pins the remedy). The history line now says the one-time sweep "closed" the backlog.
- **Kept**: H63, `staleFindingScreen`, `GRADING_STATE_LABELS`, `STALE_FINDING_LABEL` and every other H63 case. No row, gate, constant or battery is added. No battery shrank, so no pin moved.

## Why

The #29471 census listed the stale-`finding` sweep with H63 as T2. Measuring it showed H63 is the only live check on the state model's rule 「定级即离标」 (`SKILL.md:114`), it has 2 live rows, and no staying row reports a graded card that still carries `finding`. So the seat narrowed T2 to the tool alone ([#29471 comment 6593074237](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/29471#issuecomment-6593074237)). The tool was a one-time strip for a backlog that is now closed, and nothing runs it.

### The 2 stale cards

- #28107 and #28722 are graded and still carry `finding` today. This PR does not strip them, and no tool here would.
- They are left to the triage round, by hand, in the same write as their next grade (「定级即离标」).
- H63 keeps reporting both until then.

### H63's verdicts are unchanged

Measured by importing both trees (cb18498f, before the rewording, and this head) and judging all 4,096 states: every subset of 11 labels (`finding`, the six grading states, two priorities, `pm:seat`, `domain:skills`) as an open card and as a closed one.

- `staleFindingScreen` returns the same object on all 4,096 (0 differences).
- `h63StaleFindingBesideGrade` fires on the same 510 states before and after (0 verdict differences).
- On each of the 510, the new sentence equals the old one with only the remedy clause swapped (0 other differences).
- In the source, the function's diff is the two string-literal lines of that clause.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` on af3f04ec: **5161 cases pass** (5166 at a2f77f75, so 5 fewer). All 5 are the `H63 ↔ sweep` source-text cases.
- Every battery reads the same `n/floor` as at a2f77f75.
- `node scripts/pm/write-pace.mjs --self-test`: **118 cases pass**, including the roster cases that read every listed file and the "the roster IS the set of files that issue a write verb" case.
- Net lines: **+34 / −1358 (−1324)**, six files (one deleted).

<details><summary>Local gates on af3f04ec (`dispatch-gates --commands`)</summary>

- On head af3f04ec, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 80 commands (the workflow and `package.json` paths match more families than a `scripts/pm`-only card). All 80 ran, each with a 900 s timeout, with exit codes recorded before any pipe. **All 80 exited 0.**
- The `--ran` reconciliation printed: `80 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 80 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- The four build-output gates (`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`) exited 3 on cb18498f because no `dist/` existed yet. On this run the packages were built and all four measured and passed (for example, dts-closure swept 78 built packages).
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range a2f77f75..HEAD`: exit 0.
- Prerequisite: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`.
- Families CI runs beyond the derived list are read from this PR's check runs, not re-run locally.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `check-half-states.mjs:14960` still names the one-time sweep, as history: it says the sweep closed the backlog on both boards.
- `docs/audits/gate-census-2026-09.md:259,359` list `check:pm-stale-finding`. It is a dated audit, left as history.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; `pnpm lint` was not run locally, so the CI lint job decides it)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `scripts/pm/**`, the private root `package.json` and a workflow; `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (except the 维护者速读 block, which the seat contract writes in Chinese)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
